name: Neil Lindquist
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Kirkland, Washington
side_practice_areas: Personal Injury, Medical Malpractice, Transportation & Maritime
about: Based in Kirkland, Washington, attorney Neil Lindquist is a dedicated attorney whose legal career is marked by a commitment to representing plaintiffs in catastrophic injury cases, including maritime injuries. He serves as the managing partner of Kornfeld Law, bringing with him a wealth of experience of over seven years and professionalism that is set to enhance the firm's capabilities and provide significant benefits to its clients. Extending his practice to the regions of Seattle/Bellevue/Everett DMA, his practice includes maritime law, personal injury and bankruptcy, each requiring a deep understanding of the law and a compassionate approach to client representation.

Mr. Lindquist graduated from Boston College in 2013 and went on to earn his J.D. from Suffolk University Law School in 2016. During his academic tenure, he consistently earned a spot on the dean’s list and was a staff writer for the Journal of High Technology, showcasing his commitment to academic excellence and legal scholarship.

Before embarking on his legal education, Mr. Lindquist served as a United States Marine, completing two combat tours in Iraq. The skills and resilience he developed in the military have translated seamlessly into his legal career, where he is known for his aggressive advocacy on behalf of plaintiffs. This background makes him uniquely positioned to tackle the complexities and challenges of catastrophic injury cases with tenacity and a deep-seated drive for justice.

Currently, Mr. Lindquist is an active member of the Washington State Bar Association, the American Association for Justice and the Washington State Association for Justice. He is admitted to practice in Washington and before the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 9th Circuit. His approach to law is not just about legal strategy but also about understanding the human side of each case and advocating for those who have faced life-altering injuries and situations.
Neil Lindquist is a debt relief agent. He helps people file for bankruptcy relief under the Bankruptcy Code.
